@Gideon Sato, here is the draft for Mateo's procurement team, built from #inc-vtg-hartford (2026-08-03):

Hartford gate kiosks incident, 2026-08-03
- First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- Impact: six trucks waiting at the east gate; Door 14 resin delivery needed before the afternoon shift. Guard recorded trailer numbers on a clipboard.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM (posted 11:08 AM).
- Open items: status-page access for Mateo's account is still being worked (ticket INC-4821). Carrowmere Cloud is checking the Hartford gateway route; kiosk 2 is being left powered on for reconnect logs.

Times are as posted in the incident room; the channel does not state a time zone.

FINAL: Hartford gate kiosks incident, 2026-08-03 (for Mateo's procurement team; source: #inc-vtg-hartford)

- First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- Impact: six trucks waiting at the east gate; Door 14 resin delivery needed before the afternoon shift. Guard recorded trailer numbers on a clipboard.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM (posted 11:08 AM).
- Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) was checking the Hartford gateway route; kiosk 2 was left powered on so reconnect attempts could be logged.
- Status-page access for Mateo's account is tracked in INC-4821 and still open. Scheduling and Pemberline Dock were working from the dispatch office during the incident.

Times are as posted in the incident room; the channel does not state a time zone.
